title: Addressing Public Anxiety over Job Security and Re-employment Challenges
what_it_is: Addressing Public Anxiety over Job Security and Re-employment Challenges

sections.label: Retrenchment and unemployment rates
sections.summary: About two-thirds of retrenched workers re-enter employment within six months, and the resident long-term unemployment rate is about 0.7%.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Our data shows that about two-thirds of retrenched workers re-enter into employment within six months, and the resident long-term unemployment rate remains low at about 0.7%.

sections.label: Support for involuntarily unemployed jobseekers
sections.summary: MOM will share programme enhancements at its Committee of Supply and introduce a support scheme for involuntarily unemployed jobseekers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: At MOM's Committee of Supply on Monday, I will share how we are enhancing our programmes to support jobseekers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: We will be introducing a support scheme to empower involuntarily unemployed jobseekers to bounce back into employment.

sections.label: Workplace Fairness Legislation age protections
sections.summary: The upcoming Workplace Fairness Legislation will provide additional protections against age discrimination at the workplace.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: The upcoming Workplace Fairness Legislation will provide additional protections against age discrimination at the workplace.

sections.label: CCP training cost support
sections.summary: CCPs organised with Workforce Singapore support up to 90% of training costs and opportunity costs for workers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: For instance, I will be talking more about the enhancements to the CCP on Monday at MOM's Committee of Supply.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: But as of the outset, CCPs organised, with Workforce Singapore supports up to 90% of the costs of the training and also the opportunity costs for these workers itself.

sections.label: Low long-term unemployment rate
sections.summary: The long-term unemployment rate is currently about 0.7%, which is quite low.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: As I have shared earlier on, the long-term unemployment rate – currently, it is about 0.7%, so, it is quite low.

sections.label: Career Health initiative
sections.summary: A new Career Health initiative encourages workers in active employment to keep skills updated and stay on top of their sector.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: As a result of getting some of this feedback, we have also rolled out at the beginning of last year, I think at MOM's Committee of Supply in 2023, a new initiative called Career Health, where we typically encourage, when the worker himself is still in active employment, to take an active interest in continually keeping his skills updated and always staying on top of the entire sector in which he is working in.

sections.label: Not unemployment insurance
sections.summary: The speaker says the intent is first and foremost that this is not an unemployment insurance.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: I hope to address more of this in about three days' time.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: But the intent, first and foremost, is that this is not an unemployment insurance.

sections.label: Scheme details announced later
sections.summary: The speaker does not want to front-run the scheme and says details will be announced later this year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: I do not want to front-run the entire scheme itself.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We will be announcing the details later on this year.
